post_call_analysis_data.name: intake_details
post_call_analysis_data.description: Extract a JSON object with all loan intake fields discussed: loan_type (DSCR/Fix & Flip/Bridge/Unknown), property_type (Single Family/2-4 Unit/Condo/Short-Term Rental/Multi-Unit/Unknown), transaction_type (Purchase/Refinance/Cash-Out Refinance/Unknown), caller {full_name, phone, email}, dscr {occupancy_status, monthly_rent_actual, monthly_rent_market, purchase_price_or_value, target_loan_amount, ltv_percentage, monthly_pitia, credit_score_range (720+/680-719/640-679/Below 640/Unknown), liquid_reserves, vesting (Personal Name/LLC / Entity/Unknown), rent_covers_pitia (Yes/No/Unsure/Unknown), property_is_habitable, str_has_booking_history}, fix_and_flip {purchase_price, renovation_budget, after_repair_value, current_phase (Under Contract/Owned - Refinance/Need Proof of Funds/Unknown), close_of_escrow_date, project_duration (6 Months/12 Months/18+ Months/Unknown), completed_flips_last_3_years (0/1-2/3-5/5-10+/Unknown), liquidity_available, credit_score, renovation_level (Cosmetic/Moderate/Heavy/Unknown), permits_needed (Yes/No/Already Issued/Unknown)}, call_outcome {qualification_summary, follow_up_confirmed, full_app_link_provided, transitioned_from_dscr_to_ff}. Use null for any field not discussed.

post_call_analysis_data.name: success_pass_fail
post_call_analysis_data.description: Did Sergio successfully complete the consultative intake and capture a concrete next step with the prospect? True = yes, False = no.

post_call_analysis_data.name: success_score
post_call_analysis_data.description: On a scale of 1 to 10, how successfully did Sergio complete the outbound call? 10 = full intake, cross-sell discovery answered, clear next step confirmed. 1 = call ended immediately.

post_call_analysis_data.name: sergio_extras
post_call_analysis_data.description: Extract a JSON object with Sergio-specific cross-sell data: confirmed_email (string or null), confirmed_first_name (string or null), xsell_walked_away_deal {applies: 'Yes'/'No'/'Maybe'/'Not Discussed', notes: string or null}, xsell_stuck_project {applies: 'Yes'/'No'/'Maybe'/'Not Discussed', notes: string or null}, xsell_bridge_to_dscr_refi {applies: 'Yes'/'No'/'Maybe'/'Not Discussed', notes: string or null}, xsell_capital_locked_estimate {discussed: boolean, amount_description: string or null}, next_step_action (one of: 'Text Loanzify Link'/'Email Loanzify Link'/'Send Pre-Flight Analysis'/'Callback Scheduled'/'Awaiting Prospect Info'/'No Interest'/'Unable To Qualify'/'Other'/'Unknown'), next_step_notes (string or null).
